name: Bicycle Courier
subject_description: An adult East African man in his late 20s to 30s, average build, plain navy short-sleeve collared shirt with a chest pocket, dark trousers, black sandals, black crossbody shoulder bag. He carries a small pale beige clipboard in his right hand, and his plain dark-steel parcel bicycle (rear cargo rack, kickstand down) appears with him in the wide row; no logos, no readable text

extra_panels.title: Holding the clipboard
extra_panels.description: the courier holding the pale beige clipboard in his right hand at hip height, as he does when he sets it on the counter
